description: This file defines the httpCache class, which provides static methods for HTTP cache management such as caching files or content, setting cache headers, and handling client-side cache validation.

classes.name: httpCache
classes.description: A helper class for managing HTTP caching of files and content, including setting appropriate headers and handling client cache validation.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Caches a file by setting appropriate HTTP headers, optionally autodetecting MIME type.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Caches provided content with specified modification time, MIME type, and expiration, setting appropriate headers.

methods.name: checkMTime
methods.description: Checks whether the client's cached version is up-to-date based on modification time, and responds with 304 status if so.
